title: Shrimp Risotto with Croatian Twist
description: A creamy risotto dish with succulent shrimp and a hint of Croatian flair.
instructions: Heat the Croatian olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the kissed garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the silky white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, stirring occasionally.
Add the chicken broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring continuously and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
Add the shrimp and cook until they are pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley.
